Infer the cluster-level assignment design

Source: R/methods.R
dot-infer_design.Rd

Infers the cluster-level assignment design from the cluster-level law: "binom" maps to cluster-level independent Bernoulli randomization, "hypergeom" to cluster-level (stratified) complete randomization. An explicit design argument overrides the inference.

Usage

.infer_design(distC, design)

Arguments

distC

cluster-level assignment law, "binom" or "hypergeom".

design

optional override, "bernoulli" or "complete"; NULL to infer from distC.

Value

"bernoulli" or "complete".

Examples

generalClusterExp:::.infer_design("binom", NULL)       # "bernoulli"
#> [1] "bernoulli"
generalClusterExp:::.infer_design("hypergeom", NULL)   # "complete"
#> [1] "complete"
generalClusterExp:::.infer_design("binom", "complete") # explicit override
#> [1] "complete"
